_note: Source of truth for /projects/. Fill a fact by replacing its null; null renders as 'To be confirmed'. Areas (siteArea, builtArea) are numbers in m²; the pages add square feet. Folder = the project's folder in the renders source (Desktop/CAVA). Image order: the first image is the cover. coords = [lng, lat]; pin = exact | approximate | placeholder (placeholder pins are invented spots in Guanacaste until the real site is known; the page says so). hero = the home page slides, in order. Spanish: type_es, alt_es on each image, and <field>_es for any sheet field whose Spanish differs (location_es).
